abstract: INTRODUCTION: Growing teratoma syndrome is a rare occurrence with an ovarian tumor. Anesthesia has been reported to be difficult in cases of growing teratoma syndrome of the cystic type due to the pressure exerted by the tumor. However, there have been no similar reports with the solid mass type. Here, we report our experience of anesthesia in a case of growing teratoma syndrome of the solid type. CASE PRESENTATION: The patient was a 30-year-old Japanese woman who had been diagnosed with an ovarian immature teratoma at age 12 and had undergone surgery and chemotherapy. However, she dropped out of treatment. She presented to our hospital with a 40cm giant solid mass and severe respiratory failure, and was scheduled for an operation. We determined that we could not obtain a sufficient tidal volume without spontaneous respiration. Therefore, we chose to perform awake intubation and not to use a muscle relaxant before the operation. At the start of the operation, when muscle relaxant was first administered, we could not obtain a sufficient tidal volume. An abdominal midline incision was performed immediately and her tidal volume recovered. Her resected tumor weighed 10.5kg. After removal of her tumor, her tidal volume was maintained at a level consistent with that under spontaneous respiration to avoid occurrence of re-expansion pulmonary edema. CONCLUSIONS: We performed successful anesthetic management of a case of growing teratoma syndrome with a giant abdominal tumor. Respiratory management was achieved by avoiding use of a muscle relaxant before the operation to maintain spontaneous respiration and by maintaining a relatively low tidal volume, similar to that during spontaneous respiration preoperatively, after removal of the tumor to prevent re-expansion pulmonary edema.
abstract_ja:
はじめに：Growing teratoma syndromeは卵巣腫瘍にまれに生じる病態である。嚢胞型のgrowing teratoma syndromeでは、腫瘍による圧迫のため麻酔が困難であったと報告されている。しかし、充実型の腫瘤での同様の報告はない。本稿では、充実型growing teratoma syndromeの症例における麻酔の経験を報告する。
症例提示：患者は30歳の日本人女性で、12歳時に卵巣未熟奇形腫と診断され、手術と化学療法を受けていた。しかし、治療を中断していた。40cmの巨大な充実性腫瘤と重篤な呼吸不全を伴って当院を受診し、手術が予定された。自発呼吸なしには十分な換気量が得られないと判断された。そのため、術前は覚醒下挿管を選択し、筋弛緩薬は使用しなかった。手術開始時に筋弛緩薬を初めて投与したところ、十分な換気量が得られなかった。直ちに正中切開を行ったところ、換気量は回復した。切除された腫瘍の重量は10.5kgであった。腫瘍切除後は、再膨張性肺水腫を避けるため、換気量を自発呼吸時と同程度に維持した。
結論：巨大な腹部腫瘍を伴うgrowing teratoma syndromeの症例に対して、麻酔管理を成功裏に行うことができた。呼吸管理は、術前に筋弛緩薬の使用を避けて自発呼吸を維持し、腫瘍切除後は術前の自発呼吸時と同程度の比較的低い換気量を維持して再膨張性肺水腫を防ぐことで達成された。
